main.description: Objection filed against an evolution (Lv6→Lv7) advancement during the 30-day public objection window. Per ADR-2605215400 §4. If ≥1 objection is filed, the evolution remains in 'pending' status until the window closes. Only then is it finalized or reversed.

claimId.description: ID of the evolution claim being objected to.

adherentDid.description: DID of the adherent applying for advancement.

proposedLevel.description: Evolution level being objected to (currently Lv6 or Lv7; Lv7 has 30-day window per ADR-2605215400).

objectorDid.description: DID of the objector (any adherent or Council member, depending on level). For Lv7, typically a Council member or active witness.

narrative.description: Detailed objection narrative. Public and permanent record.

evidenceCid.description: Optional IPFS CID of supporting evidence (document, attestation, forensic data).

filedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when objection was filed (within appeal window).
